name: Mate and bombilla set
where: Mercado de los Artesanos, Plaza Cagancha
about: Mate is a bitter herbal tea shared from a gourd, and it is part of everyday life in Uruguay. The metal straw, called a bombilla, is used to drink it.
tip: Check the material: leather, gourd, and metal are the common options.

name: Tannat wine
about: Tannat is a dark, full-bodied red grape that is Uruguay's signature variety. It is widely grown and sold across the country.
tip: Look for Tannat on the label to get the country's main red wine style.
